content: dataclasses.asdict() recurses into dataclasses, dicts, lists and tuples; all other objects are copied with copy.deepcopy(). No special-casing for frozen= or slots=. For iol Phase 30 models every leaf is a scalar (str/int/float/None), so the deepcopy leg is trivially cheap and carries no shared-mutable hazard. Nested Punta and list[Punta] flatten to plain dicts, which is exactly what verification.schema.schema_of needs.
